0510.why: Well-executed dashboard with clear card-based layout and professional polish. State indicators (recording badges, scheduled times) are visible and properly emphasized. However, follows familiar product dashboard patterns; lacks distinctive visual language compared to top-tier tools.

observation.happening: Minimal floating recording control bar; displays active recording state, elapsed time counter, and contextual action buttons
observation.most_important: Recording state (red dot + 記音中 label) immediately legible; timer tracking; dark background keeps UI peripheral
observation.next_action: Take memo, enable captions, ask Astra, or stop recording

05F6.why: Exceptionally tight control bar with minimal visual weight; dark pill shape keeps recording controls peripheral during active session. Execution is flawless, but the floating recording bar is a standard UI pattern across audio/video platforms.

observation.happening: Meeting detail view with extracted summary, structured decisions/action items (with counters), and timestamped transcript showing speaker contributions
observation.most_important: Multi-level information hierarchy: summary → decisions [1][2] → actions [3][4][5] → transcript with speaker names and timestamps; action items are directly callable

0C0F.why: Exceptional meeting detail view with flawless information architecture. Multi-level extraction (summary → decisions → actions → transcript) is semantically clear and visually organized. Typography hierarchy (section headers with counts, numbered items, timestamps, speaker names) is exemplary. Transcript row structure (time | speaker | content) is thoughtfully designed for rapid scanning. No visual flaws; distinctive Astra-specific implementation that rivals top productivity tools.
